SELECT SEQ_DRIVE_ITEM_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_DRIVE( DRIVE_ITEM_ID, PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, EMP_ID, ITEM_TYPE_CD, BOOKMARK_YN, ITEM_NM, FRST_REG_DT, DEL_YN )VALUES( #{driveItemId}, #{prntDriveItemId}, #{empId}, #{itemTypeCd}, 'N', #{itemNm}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT DRIVE_ITEM_ID, PRNT_DRIVE_ITEM_ID, EMP_ID, ITEM_TYPE_CD, BOOKMARK_YN, ITEM_NM, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM TB_DRIVE D LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_CLSF CLSF ON D.DRIVE_ATCH_FILE_ID = CLSF.ATCH_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CMMN_ATCH_FILE_DTL DTL ON CLSF.ATCH_FILE_ID = DTL.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY ITEM_TYPE_CD ASC, FRST_REG_DT ASC
